item.title: Ente digest Aug 22, 2026 - 15 shipped, 5 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work focused on a refreshed Auth experience, stronger server-side consistency around Trash and recovery, and Ensu desktop and Android improvements. In progress, Photos and Locker are getting notable interaction upgrades, including a better scanner and a new photo viewer.

Shipped

  • Ente Auth: The web Auth and Locker apps now use a new authentication layout: Auth and Locker. Linux installations now appear as Ente Auth in the launcher via #12342.
  • Ensu: Desktop now supports Ensu Packs through #12343. Android backups and device-to-device transfers are disabled to prevent restored data from causing startup failures after reinstall or migration: #12366.
  • Photos mobile: Memory Lane’s service received further cleanup in #12363 and #12319. Shared feature-flag handling was also moved into a reusable mobile package via #12280.
  • Server: Collection additions, moves, restores, and permanent Trash deletion now serialize more safely, reducing races that could incorrectly reactivate or delete files: #12339 and #12356. Request validation, transaction cleanup, and Space web-push provider validation also improved in #12360 and #12353.
  • Account recovery can now specify whether existing sessions stay signed in; they are signed out by default when unspecified: #12352.
  • Minor web localization updates landed in #12358 and #12357.

In progress

  • Locker: A substantially improved document scanner adds auto-capture, animated thumbnails, better review controls, haptics, and a magnified crop-adjustment loupe: #12371.
  • Photos mobile: A new Ente-owned photo viewer replaces photo_view and zooms toward the double-tapped point while retaining existing gestures and transitions: #12368. Memory Lane is also being extended to create timelines from lone clusters in #12367.
  • iOS cold-start sharing is being fixed in #12365, while icon coverage and dark-mode visibility are being improved in #12373.

item.title: Ente digest Aug 21, 2026 - 27 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
A busy day for Ente Photos, with a broad refresh of web authentication screens, music arriving in Memories behind a feature flag, and several server and upload reliability improvements. Desktop Ensu Packs support and large-file S3 copying are now in progress.

Shipped

  • Photos web: Authentication and recovery flows now use refreshed layouts, including login, password entry and reset, 2FA, recovery, email verification, passkey status, and the 2FA choice screen: login, password entry, password reset, 2FA authentication, 2FA and recovery key entry, recovery, email verification and passkey status, and 2FA choice. Additional animations and polish landed in the auth layout via #12340.
  • Photos mobile: Memories can now include music, currently behind an internal feature flag and tested on Android and iOS (#12334). Memory-lane caching also supports lanes for lone, unnamed people clusters (#12305).
  • Server: Account recovery can specify whether existing sessions stay signed in; if omitted, sessions are signed out by default (#12352). Authentication request handling, TOTP completion and tracking, passkey errors, and sensitive logging were also tightened in #12335 and #12328.
  • Reliability and performance: Collection updates are better serialized with Trash operations (#12339), batch file operations use more efficient database upserts (#12198), and mobile multipart checksums now stream encrypted data, reducing benchmarked peak memory by 65% (#12306).
  • Additional maintenance covered multipart-object cleanup and registration races (#12320, #12324), model-runtime identity handling (#12321), and the ONNX Runtime upgrade (#12323).

In progress

  • Upcoming desktop feature: Ensu Packs support is being added to the desktop app (#12343).
  • Server uploads: Large files are being prepared for multipart S3 copying (#12337).
  • Smaller ongoing work includes using “Ente Auth” as the Linux launcher name (#12342) and cleaning up the Photos memory-lane service (#12319, #12346).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 20, 2026 - 32 shipped, 5 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos improvements across mobile and web, including smoother authentication, better gallery behavior, and lower-memory uploads. Library Sharing is now enabled for all users, while video playback controls and other platform work are progressing.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Memory Lane caches can now represent unnamed people clusters, enabling memory lanes for lone clusters (#12305). Week grouping was also corrected to ISO Monday–Sunday ranges and optimized with cached scans (#12287).
  • Photos mobile: Multipart checksums now stream directly from encrypted chunks, reducing peak memory use by about 65% in testing and improving processing time by about 9% (#12306). Cloudflare-backed uploads were expanded from 20% to 50% of users (#12284).
  • Photos mobile: Local-gallery diagnostics now log local IDs and support local_ids: searches, making failed ML indexing cases easier to investigate (#12304). The backup mode UI and trash interactions also received usability and layout fixes (#12251, #12286, #12281).
  • Photos web: Login, signup, and authentication flows now use the newer component shell, with cancellation handled without showing a misleading error (#12318, #12314, #12303, #12292, #12283).
  • Accounts and server: Library Sharing is enabled for all users, and subscription verification was refined (#12289, #12268).
  • Other shipped work included mobile purchase-dependency upgrades, Rust secret-handling improvements, and routine cleanup (#12316, #12291, #12315).

In progress

  • Upcoming Photos feature: Video playback speed controls are being added to the viewer, with speeds from 0.25× to 2× and state preserved across stream/player changes (#12313).
  • Photos mobile: Apple Photos save-permission handling is under development (#12302), alongside memory-lane service cleanup (#12319).
  • Infrastructure: Multipart-upload cleanup is being improved so completed temporary uploads are deleted correctly (#12320), and ONNX sessions are being bound to model identity to avoid stale model state (#12321).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 19, 2026 - 21 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a busy set of Photos improvements today, including album slideshows, better Trash behavior, shared-link descriptions, and broader rollout of faster uploads. The release also includes reliability fixes across mobile, web, Locker, and the server.

Shipped

  • Ente Photos mobile: Added album slideshows, included album descriptions in shared links, and added a confirmation toast after restoring items from device Trash.
  • Trash improvements: The Delete all action now stays fully visible above Android navigation and uses destructive styling via the layout fix and the shared FAB update. Emptying Trash and permanent-delete confirmation were also refined in this change.
  • Photos reliability: Fixed a crash when opening Ente Trash in #12271, a custom scrollbar panic on empty galleries in #12266, and playback of trashed videos on Android in #12273. Cloudflare uploads are now rolling out to 50% of mobile users via #12284.
  • Photos web: Items from the hidden section can now be added to the hidden album in #12275. Paste handling was moved to Rust in #12277.
  • Server: Free public links now default to 10 devices in #12249; subscription handling and Cast request validation were refined in #12268 and #12260.
  • Other: Photos startup issues caused by the Rust library rename were fixed in #12259, and Locker Android release sizes were reduced in #12265. Minor dependency, email, icon, and ignore-file maintenance was also merged.

In progress

  • Photos mobile: Week grouping is being corrected and optimized with ISO Monday-to-Sunday ranges in #12287. Trash pages are also receiving spacing and empty-state illustration polish in #12288 and #12286.
  • Locker: Scanner follow-ups improve document detection, GPU handling, and cleanup in #12282; the scanner remains disabled behind its feature flag.
  • Web and mobile: Account-deletion authentication cancellation is being handled cleanly in #12283, while Photos feature flags are moving into a shared package in #12280. Documentation updates are proposed in #12285.

item.title: Ente digest Aug 18, 2026 - 28 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of performance improvements for large Photos libraries, alongside Library Sharing and video-streaming rollouts. Locker also gained the foundations of a document scanner, while several mobile usability fixes and platform improvements moved forward.

Shipped

  • Ente Photos mobile: Timeline loading is now substantially faster for large galleries, with a reported 6.7× improvement on a 95,000-photo library (#12256). Search and Smart Memories also reuse more computed data and process fewer files, improving responsiveness at scale (#12257).
  • Photo maps now keep more work off the UI thread and use faster Rust-based clustering, making navigation smoother with many geotagged photos (#12224, #12246).
  • Library Sharing: Sharing text is localized, and its configuration can now sync across devices for supported internal users (#12241, #12238). The server now supports the encrypted sharing entities behind the feature (#12233).
  • Video streaming is now enabled for all users (#12235). Photos also gained local-gallery trash controls and trash pages (#12247, #11785, #11781).
  • Ente Locker: Rust/Flutter bridge wiring landed, followed by a document-scanning pipeline with perspective correction and image enhancement. The scanner remains disabled behind a feature flag (#12227, #12240).
  • Photos startup is fixed on affected platforms through the completed Rust binding rename; Rust crate names are now standardized (#12259, #12248). Cast pairing also adds post-quantum encryption (#12236).

In progress

  • Upcoming Photos improvements: iOS background ML is being made reliable through background processing tasks (#12242), and the video player is gaining double-tap ±5-second seeking (#12234).
  • Free public links may soon allow up to 10 devices by default (#12249).
  • Other open work updates the Photos backup-mode UI (#12251), adds trash-file support to the native video player (#12253), and adds an AirVPN icon (#12255).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 17, 2026 - 1 shipped, 4 in progress
item.description:
A quieter day for shipped changes, with a server-side fix improving subscription reliability. Mobile work is progressing on Locker’s Rust foundation, Photos performance, privacy controls, and code cleanup.

Shipped

  • Server: Ignore stale subscription verification replays prevents older App Store, Stripe, or Google Play purchase receipts from rolling a user’s subscription entitlement backward, while still allowing legitimate provider or product changes.

In progress

  • Photos: Move photo map clustering off the UI thread moves map filtering and marker clustering to a background worker, aiming to keep the app responsive for large libraries. It also updates the map library and cache implementation.
  • Photos: Stop Memory Lane when ML is disabled gates Memory Lane startup and its UI on global ML consent, while allowing an already-running person-processing job to finish.
  • Locker: Wire Rust into Locker with per-app FRB bridges lays the groundwork for Locker-specific Rust integration through a new bridge and build flow. The description identifies this as the first of two PRs, with a document scanner feature planned in the follow-up.
  • Mobile maintenance: Prune comments - Part 4 continues cleanup of comments in the mobile codebase.

item.title: Ente digest Aug 15, 2026 - 14 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped changes focus on smoother Photos workflows across mobile, web, and desktop, alongside reliability and security improvements under the hood. Several follow-up changes are in progress, including faster ML syncing and safer subscription handling.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Foreground and background ML work can no longer run concurrently, preventing conflicting database writes and inconsistent search indexes in PR #12162. Selection actions were reordered around common tasks, and Share now uses the platform-appropriate icon in PR #12199. The storage-card loading spinner was also centered in PR #12197.
  • Photos desktop: The Add Person dialog now includes search, making it easier to find people in larger libraries (PR #12202).
  • Web: Fixed a referral double-click issue and removed outdated rs naming from album details and account references (PR #12211, PR #12209, PR #12175).
  • Maintenance: ML was moved into its own Rust crate (PR #12196), deprecated crypto dependencies were replaced or aligned with HPKE (PR #12200, PR #12203), and the server toolchain received security fixes via Go 1.26.6 (PR #12201).

In progress

  • Faster ML sync: PR #12207 defers CLIP vector-index saves, reducing repeated full-database writes during device hydration and improving crash resilience.
  • Subscription reliability: PR #12205 prevents stale purchase replays from rolling an active subscription backward.
  • Photos UX: Album selection will disable accidental tab swiping (PR #12204), while desktop title bars will follow the app theme (PR #12208).
  • Additional work batches collection-file database upserts for better server efficiency (PR #12198), and adds missing Photos mobile changelog entries (PR #12212).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 14, 2026 - 22 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a strong set of Photos improvements across album editing, account deletion, backup reliability, and large-gallery performance. The day also brought backend consistency fixes and continued Rust ML infrastructure work, while several mobile and server enhancements are now in progress.

Shipped

  • Photos web — album editing: Albums can now edit their title and description from a dedicated dialog, with cover-image editing moved into the same flow and descriptions shown where relevant. PR #12176, PR #12181, PR #12186, PR #12191
  • Photos web — account deletion: The deletion flow is more robust, including a visible error state when summary data cannot be loaded, plus translation fixes. PR #12188, PR #12190
  • Photos mobile: Backup Status now shows per-file foreground upload progress and retries multipart uploads that receive HTTP 520 errors. Large galleries also use faster lookups, improving timeline layout performance. PR #12172, PR #12165
  • Server: Collection trash operations now keep each batch atomic, preventing partially processed collections from becoming difficult to recover. PR #12177
  • Mobile security: Obscured PIN digits are no longer exposed through Flutter widget keys or diagnostics. PR #12173
  • Rust ML: ML was moved into its own crate, while the ONNX runtime and provider handling were further modularized. PR #12196, PR #12163
  • Additional shipped maintenance included simpler disabled-album guest joining, timezone handling for single-file links, and removal of Space profile post-date grouping. PR #12180, PR #12178, PR #12189

In progress

  • Photos mobile: Selection actions are being reordered around common usage, and sharing will use platform-specific icons. PR #12199
  • Photos mobile: Shared media is being updated to preserve file extensions, filenames, and MIME types. PR #12187
  • Server: Collection file upserts are being batched into database statements to reduce transaction round trips for large operations. PR #12198
  • A storage-card loading spinner alignment fix, Guest view documentation, and an accounts package rename are also in progress. PR #12197, PR #12182, PR #12175

item.title: Ente digest Aug 13, 2026 - 31 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a concentrated set of Photos improvements today, including faster and more responsive mobile galleries, clearer backup progress, and fixes for edited-photo syncing. Web albums and public links also received usability fixes, while several backend and ML reliability changes are in progress.

Shipped

Ente Photos mobile

  • Backup uploads now show per-file foreground progress, and multipart uploads retry HTTP 520 failures up to three times.
  • New photos from a device appear in the home timeline sooner, without waiting for a full library reload.
  • Large galleries use faster timeline lookups, improving layout performance as libraries grow.
  • Edited iOS photos are now synced correctly after origin fetches, and edited photos remain next to their originals in the detail viewer.
  • Unnecessary home-gallery reloads are avoided, while device collection cover updates are made safer during concurrent database operations.
  • Rituals with every day disabled no longer trigger an unnecessary notification permission request. System trash file tracking is also supported via this change.

Web and desktop

  • Single-file album quick links now handle timezone differences, and query-token public album links have been restored.
  • The Ensu settings modal works correctly on macOS.

Reliability and maintenance

  • Canceled server requests are classified as client-closed without noisy error-level logging.
  • Accounts migrations, telemetry/build cleanup, and related maintenance shipped in Photos, Auth, and the web apps.

In progress

  • Web Photos: album details editing will let users edit both an album title and description; cover editing is planned for a follow-up.
  • Photos mobile: foreground and background ML runs will be prevented from running concurrently, avoiding database contention and conflicting index writes.
  • The Rust ML runtime and ONNX support are being refactored to clarify provider handling, model management, and runtime behavior.
  • Server collection-trash batches are being made atomic so interrupted deletions can be retried safely.
  • PIN widget keys are being hardened so obscured PIN digits do not appear in Flutter diagnostics.
  • The web accounts package is being renamed from accounts-rs to accounts.

item.title: Ente digest Aug 12, 2026 - 34 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos, Auth, Locker, and platform improvements, with a focus on smoother media handling, better diagnostics, and safer account infrastructure. Several new mobile capabilities are also in progress, including native thumbnail loading and Locker-based 2FA setup.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Shared PIN entry now powers app lock, email verification, and Photos while retaining one-time-code autofill and completion behavior (#12127). Smart Memories calculations are more efficient, and several Memories, search, and image-editor issues were fixed (#12068, #12087, #12097).
  • Photos OCR: OCR selection controls are now integrated directly into the viewer and remain reachable around letterboxed images (#12105, #12089).
  • Photos web and desktop: Thumbnail generation no longer upscales smaller media, reducing unnecessary processing while preserving source dimensions (#12118). Web video timestamps now fall back to UTC creation times when needed (#12128).
  • Auth: macOS Auth can now run as an opt-in menubar app with a compact popover and a fallback full window (#11235). Web Auth migrated to accounts-rs, with Argon2 work moved off the main thread (#12141, #12079).
  • Locker: Unsaved edits are handled correctly, offline users see cached item counts, and Legacy Kit sharing now cleans up temporary files (#12080, #12057, #12114).
  • Reliability and security: Photos Rust ML now reports actionable errors and slow analyses (#12125), while the server prevents revoked sessions from returning to cache and redacts recovery credentials from logs (#12071, #12110).

In progress

  • Upcoming Locker feature: Set up two-factor authentication directly from Locker (#12123).
  • Upcoming Photos groundwork: A native, cancellable thumbnail API for Android and iOS is being added; app integration will follow separately (#12134).
  • Ente-owned file export is replacing file_saver across mobile and desktop platforms (#12136), alongside a shared floating action button component (#12117).
  • Mobile billing FAQ presentation and malformed-data handling are being hardened (#12138); canceled server requests are being classified as client-closed responses (#12135).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 11, 2026 - 37 shipped, 9 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos usability improvements across mobile and web, alongside several server-side security and reliability hardenings. Work in progress continues on OCR, gallery polish, Locker editing, and session protection.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Search results now prioritize sections based on query intent, such as Magic for general searches, Moments for dates, and Files for filename or type queries (#11101). Smart Memories calculations are more efficient through batched processing (#12068) and lower-memory CLIP selection (#12013).
  • OCR selection controls remain reachable and behave more predictably in the full-screen viewer (#12089). Video trimming also selects the nearest handle when touch targets overlap (#12085), and the viewer’s exit animation no longer shows multiple images flying across the screen (#12044).
  • Large iOS backups can now keep the device awake while dimming the display (#12066). Free Up Space recovery was hardened against crashes on some Samsung devices (#11802), and older Museum installations now handle missing file URL endpoints gracefully (#12098).
  • Photos web: All Albums gains filters for shared, received, and quick-link albums, plus bulk deletion of empty albums (#12095). Searching for “No Location” now finds files without valid location data (#12076).
  • Ensu desktop: Chats can be renamed through a dialog (#12060).
  • Server and security: Stripe sessions are now bound to users (#12092), payment redirects were hardened (#12091), and email construction was tightened (#12094). Obsolete endpoints, migration code, libraries, and campaign support were removed (#12106, #12093, #12088).
  • Other maintenance included vulnerable dependency patches, nightly Rust CodeQL analysis, release-tag automation, and related cleanup (#12102, #12064, #12074).

In progress

  • Upcoming Photos web polish: improved mobile upload styling and removal of quick links from the gallery header (#12108).
  • Photos mobile: an app-owned inline OCR selection UI is being integrated (#12105), alongside fixes for the editor’s neutral sharpness slider (#12097) and Memories/search state handling (#12087).
  • Locker is adding safer handling for unsaved edits and collection changes (#12080). Server work is addressing session access after storage-warning grace expiry (#12107) and preventing revoked sessions from returning to cache (#12071).
  • Argon2 key derivation is being moved off the web main thread (#12079), and Photos 1.3.60 feature documentation is being updated (#12082).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 10, 2026 - 9 shipped, 4 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work focuses on reliability and usability across Ente Photos, Locker, and shared mobile infrastructure. Several performance and offline improvements are also in progress, alongside a new backup mode and desktop chat renaming for Ensu.

Shipped

Ente Photos

  • Fixed cross-year “On This Day” scheduling, preventing January memories from appearing a day early around midnight and year boundaries.
  • Fixed a “Free Up Space” crash on some Samsung Android devices by replacing an unsafe per-file deletion fallback with a bounded recovery flow.
  • Improved payment error handling: disconnected payment pages now show the standard network error dialog instead of a broken page or exposed URL.
  • Reworked device health checks behind a Photos-owned platform bridge, with clearer handling for stale, unsupported, or unavailable system signals.

Locker and shared mobile

  • Prevented sharing-menu freezes in Locker by building menu items lazily for large participant lists.
  • Unified email composition across Photos, Auth, and Locker, including improved attachment targeting and iOS fallback behavior.
  • Improved the log viewer across all three apps with complete history paging, search navigation, session navigation, refresh, and sharing.

Web: Fixed the bad-face clustering check. Infrastructure also gained nightly Rust CodeQL analysis via this update.

In progress

  • Photos: batch Smart Memories calculations to reuse input data and compute current and upcoming periods more efficiently.
  • Photos: iOS Backup mode, which keeps the device awake and dims the display during large backups.
  • Ensu Desktop: rename chats through a save/cancel dialog.
  • Locker offline item counts will show the last cached count instead of spinning indefinitely.

item.title: Ente digest Aug 09, 2026 - 6 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
Today’s activity focused on improving search and shared mobile UI across Ente Auth and Photos, along with more robust error handling. Several usability and support improvements are also in progress, including a unified log viewer and better self-hosting setup on Ubuntu.

Shipped

  • Ente Auth: Desktop users can now start searching simply by typing on the home page, while mobile type-to-search preserves IME input for languages that rely on composition (#11352, #12053).
  • Ente Photos: Mobile users can search by uploaded file ID, making it easier to locate a specific file (#12051).
  • Mobile apps: Auth now uses shared button and divider components, and update notifications use one consistent themed sheet across the apps, with changelog links and a persistent notification preference (#12052, #12049).
  • Photos reliability: Non-JSON API failures are now converted into sanitized local errors instead of exposing raw responses or creating Sentry breadcrumbs (#12048).

In progress

  • Shared mobile log viewer: A new unified viewer for Auth, Photos, and Locker would support complete log history, searchable matches, session navigation, and refresh (#12054).
  • Photos payments: Disconnections in the payment webview would show Ente’s standard network error dialog instead of a broken page or exposed URL (#12047).
  • Self-hosting: The setup command is being switched from sh to bash to fix installation errors on Ubuntu 24.04 (#12045).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 08, 2026 - 32 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos improvements across web and mobile, with better upload resilience, account isolation, recovery flows, and responsive UI. Work in progress is focused on polishing the mobile viewing experience and tightening Photos behavior around hidden content and face clustering.

Shipped

  • Photos — mobile: Upload components are now mobile responsive in PR #12031, while the new album description UI landed in PR #11920. The memories and gallery file viewers also received a UI update in PR #12001.
  • Photos — uploads and editing: Ente removed the whole-file upload timeout, avoiding false timeout reports when iOS is backgrounded or paused (PR #12024). Video editing now uses Ente-owned native frame extraction and editing, with Android exports clamped to the actual video duration (PR #12009).
  • Photos — reliability: Social feed items and comment drafts are now isolated between account sessions (PR #12037), and stale progress dialogs are dismissed during lifecycle changes (PR #12035). Device-only deletion also clears stale local file IDs across all collections (PR #11366).
  • Photos — web: Public album errors now receive improved handling (PR #12043), and Legacy Kit recovery sheets can be recovered from metadata, printed keys, or QR codes (PR #12029).
  • Accounts and Auth: Web accounts and embeds migrated to accounts-rs (PR #12030, PR #12025). iOS Auth QR scans now stay within the visible frame (PR #12033), and Auth added an ONEROXE icon (PR #12015).
  • Other shipped work included more graceful unavailable-content handling in Space (PR #12028) and support for up to 20 GiB Photos uploads for internal users (PR #12027). Remaining changes were maintenance and dependency cleanup.

In progress

  • Photos — mobile: A fix prevents multiple cached images from flying across the screen when exiting the full-screen viewer (PR #12044).
  • Reopening the app after backgrounding it from Hidden will now return to Home instead of displaying hidden content (PR #12036).
  • Photos — web: A fix is underway for the bad-face clustering check (PR #12041).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 07, 2026 - 30 shipped, 10 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work focused on improving Photos’ album and memory experiences, consolidating mobile UI, and making uploads and ML processing more reliable. Several platform cleanups also landed, while upcoming work includes a new web embed migration and a native video-editing stack.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Albums can now include descriptions via #11920, and file details show cleaner aperture and focal-length values through #11947. Smart Memories date-boundary handling was fixed in #11972, while direct People navigation now returns the correct files for the “Only Them” filter in #11990.
  • Mobile platform: Auth, Locker, and Photos now share more settings UI and components, reducing duplication, via #11932. Accounts buttons were migrated to the current button component in #12022.
  • Locker: Remaining legacy sharing controls were migrated to Locker-owned components without changing sharing or deletion behavior in #12023.
  • Web: Casting no longer depends on the stale accounts package in #12021. Bounded-memory multipart uploads can defer checksum calculation until each part is sent in #11997.
  • Auth: Ente Auth now includes a branded ONEROXE icon for TOTP accounts in #12015.
  • ML and infrastructure: Device-aware model selection and faster knowledge retrieval landed in #11995 and #11998. Photos indexing now scopes execution-provider retries to the affected model in #11979.
  • Additional maintenance covered desktop dependencies, Rust and Go cleanup, worker URLs and validation, Space organization, viewer behavior, and documentation: #12000, #12017, #12016, #12008, #11994, #11986, #11987, #11983, #11982, #11984, #11981, #11975, #11989, #11993, and #11955.

In progress

  • Upcoming web embed work: Migrate the embed experience to accounts-rs in #12025.
  • Photos mobile: Remove the problematic whole-file upload timeout in #12024,

item.title: Ente digest Aug 06, 2026 - 30 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos improvements today, including safer library sharing, more reliable Smart Memories, clearer metadata, and smoother people suggestions. The day also brought shared mobile settings infrastructure and several performance, security, and maintenance updates.

Shipped

  • Photos — sharing: Library sharing selection is easier to use: tap albums to select them, long-press to open them, and keep “Stop sharing” available when controls collapse (#11951). Recipient identity checks were also hardened in both the mobile client (#11949) and server (#11944).
  • Photos — memories and people: Smart Memories now handles month- and year-boundary anniversaries correctly (#11972), while people suggestions refresh correctly after review feedback, including undo (#11948).
  • Photos — mobile polish: File details now format aperture and focal length to at most two decimal places (#11947), Trash opened through Free Up Space requires local authentication (#11940), and the memories banner animation was optimized (#11929).
  • Mobile platform: Auth, Locker, and Photos now share common settings components, reducing duplication across apps (#11932). Photos localization was expanded, and Auth signup now preserves keys through SRP setup failures (#11977, #11963).
  • Performance and reliability: Similar Images uses substantially less bulk-search memory, and ML detection/crop processing was tightened (#11974, #11967). Ensu model downloads are now pinned and hosted through Ente-controlled repositories (#11959).
  • Smaller documentation, web cleanup, self-hosting, changelog, and TIFF-decoder maintenance updates also landed (docs, self-hosting, changelog, TIFF).

In progress

  • Upcoming Ensu feature: Desktop chat rows can now be renamed using an edit icon shown on hover or focus (#11971).
  • Photos rituals: The notification permission prompt will be skipped when all ritual days are disabled, avoiding an irrelevant or blocking request (#11969).
  • Photos ML execution-provider retries are being scoped to the affected model instead of replaying unrelated indexing work (#11979).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 05, 2026 - 23 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a set of Photos security, sharing, indexing, and download improvements across mobile and web. Work in progress includes album descriptions, shared settings infrastructure, and tighter server-side sharing checks.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Trash now requires local authentication even when opened through Free Up Space in PR #11940. Logout now clears social and favorites caches, preventing data from a previous account from appearing after switching accounts, in PR #11787.

item.title: Ente digest Aug 01, 2026 - 21 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a strong set of Photos improvements across mobile, web, and desktop, including a faster panorama experience, more relevant face suggestions, and better handling of storage-related backup failures. Work in progress includes bulk collection sharing on the server and fixes for a device-space cleanup crash.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: A new in-tree panorama viewer improves first-open performance, keeps thumbnails visible while rendering, supports crop-aware zoom and motion viewing, and avoids camera jumps on mobile. Face suggestions now filter out low-quality or repeatedly rejected matches, making recommendations more relevant (#11817), and pinned people are visibly marked in search (#11810).
  • Backups now detect when the device is out of storage, stop pending uploads safely, and show an actionable error instead of repeatedly retrying and consuming more space (#11554). Own-collection timestamps also survive synchronization replay (#11752).
  • Photos web and desktop: Legacy recovery-sheet decoding is now bounded according to image orientation (#11820), and the web collection-map dialog no longer unnecessarily re-renders after a remote pull (#11804). Desktop also fixes the initial height of the All People modal (#11815).
  • Photos desktop: Native bindings now target Node-API 10 for Electron 42, improving compatibility with the bundled runtime (#11814). Corrupt ML models no longer trigger futile download retries; indexing is suspended instead (#11806).
  • Other: Desktop Space users can copy profile links (#11816), and mobile in-app purchases were updated for Google Play Billing 8 while retaining iOS receipt compatibility (#11730).

In progress

  • Upcoming sharing capability: The server is adding bounded bulk share and unshare endpoints for a single recipient, including idempotent automatic sharing and viewer-only uncategorized sharing (#11809).
  • Free Up Space is being hardened against Android bulk-deletion failures that could trigger hundreds of individual deletion calls and crash the app (#11802).
  • Shared legacy layout and autofocus components are being migrated into Ente Components, with no intended visual changes (#11812).
